entities.summary:
Iphicrates was a key Athenian general who flourished in the earlier half of the 4th century BC.

He played a pivotal role in the development of ancient Greek warfare, introducing the 'hoplite' formation that would become the backbone of the phalanx formation.

Iphicrates' innovations significantly influenced the military tactics and strategies of the ancient Greeks, leaving a lasting impact on the development of Western warfare.
